g.text: separate metadata and DEV settings keys
Six write actions await a fresh token before dispatch.
Failure or stale intent sends no business request.
Active executions retain their original credentials.
Saved headers survive reload in their environment.
Header edits do not alter an existing snapshot.
Server secrets are write-only from the browser.
LocalAuthConfig changes only after successful saving.
Proxy checks the confirmed connection version.
Reconciliation never replays a write request.
Only create or accepted user activity changes recent order.
Pinning changes the group, not lastActivityAt.
DEV auth has no production or preview registration.
Return accessToken only; no browser cookies.
